description: Temporary client-only causal probe, retaining all diagnostic timers. Compare full pending-map scan on every loop against same scan at most once per millisecond. Per-response timeout guard remains unchanged, so late certificates are never accepted; timeout collection may run later. No validator, journal, admission, signature or quorum changes. Two throttled runs followed by a restored full-scan run, all1900offeredTPS/9500transactions/20msonewaydelay/5sdeadline. Instrumented source restored byte-for-byte afterward. Not a shipped optimization or replacement capacity benchmark.

initial_full_scan_report.measurement_definition: Signed transaction submission before transport enqueue to client receipt and strict Ed25519 verification of effects QC; client generation/signing excluded; network queues, fixed per-direction delay, validator validation/signing and group sync_all before votes included.
initial_full_scan_report.limits: One host, loopback TCP, fixed one-way delay without packet-loss/bandwidth modelling; one hot collective pool; bounded journal group commit; filesystem/device sync_all guarantees assumed. Finalized latency percentiles are conditional; all-submitted quantiles include right-censored stalls.

interpretation: Changing only client scan frequency substantially reduced queueing and increased finalized throughput; restoration reproduced slowdown. Supports a causal client bottleneck, not a new validator capacity claim. All signatures, quorum rules, validator persistence and per-response timeout guards remained unchanged. Throttling is a temporary diagnostic variant; production client still uses original full scan. A deadline-ordered expiration queue is the proposed proper fix.
